| # Object 0x1381 to 0x1390 SRDO mapping parameter {#object-0x1381-to-0x1390-srdo-mapping-parameter-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

These objects shall contain the mapping parameters for the SRDO\'s the device is able to receive or transmit.

 

  Index         0x1381 to 0x1390
  ------------- -----------------------------------
  Name          SRDO Mapping Parameter
  Object Code   RECORD
  Data Type     SRDO parameter
  Category      Mandatory for each supported SRDO

 

 

SubIndex Supported

  SubIndex      0
  ------------- ----------------------------
  Description   Highest SubIndex Supported

 

  SubIndex      1,3,5,7,9,11,13 to 15(only odd indices)
  ------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Description   SRDO mapping for the n-th application object to be mapped (data not inverted)

 

  SubIndex      2,4,6,8,10,12,14 to 16(only even indices)
  ------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Description   SRDO mapping for the n-th application object to be mapped (data inverted)

 

  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ![Info](info.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.6979in;border:none"}   Up to 16 entries supported i.e if object size is 1 bytes then 8 objects can be mapped. Dynamic mapping is supported and by default all mapping entry is set to 0. ASW is responsible for setting valid mapping for each SRDO.
  -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
